folds.heading: ## Round-note and terminal-state content reconciliation, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
Full review of R10–R14 reconciliation notes, the pre-R12 checkpoint and this R15 checkpoint preserves their corrections before reusing the prompts. Review setting High3of3 was observed, while the model name was not displayed. Full copied replies/screenshots are reported artifacts, not inspected source or played outcomes here. The notes correct real distinctions: natural balance versus acquired grip/rope; identified-object container boundaries versus capability expiry or the Eda loan; actual facility allocation versus plausible station names; and 102 coins/zero paid versus the erroneous 1020. None creates a generic inventory, support or recovery framework (AD32, AD36).

Pre-R12’s error-stopped natural action and retained profile do not prove payment, useful food or changed positive import. R10 post-attempt state was unavailable and was not reconstructed; R8 fail-closed remains history. Zero attempts used does not grant another allowance, and exact predecessor release cannot be inferred from a proposed handoff. Later R15 integrations supersede earlier pending states only for their named groups and snapshots. Preserve the 618/621/628/634 test counts separately and the initial CH1 interrupted gate before its successful retry.

The final October 14 entries override the initial active/watch instructions: the coordinator stopped, W1 ended incomplete with all 15 section gates open and its exact tested tip unmerged at that check. These are dated statements, not current blockers, live processes or renewed merge/push/resume authority. The original recovery routes, useful open leaves and worker evidence remain intact. No profile, private companion, live worker, remote state, test or gameplay was accessed by this documentation review.
